start_policy: Requires all56 MSD runs complete, locally verified archives and cleanup; remote gate rechecks. Does not replace or cancel the current MSD continuation.
pause_policy: Pauses ADNI only and preserves optimizer/RNG/sampling state; never clears a user pause automatically.
archive_policy: Finish Dice/FN/FP evaluation, archive and verify locally, then delete only completed generated bulky artifacts. ADNI has no anterior/posterior labels.
offline_policy: After300 seconds waiting for local archive, release GPU and retain recovery; collector resumes after archive returns unless manually paused.
